description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt project to control and set the status LEDs based on device board types and system states. It defines functions to get the appropriate status LED and set its state according to different system phases.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines and sets the appropriate status LED based on board name.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided system state argument.
